name: Hypixel Zombies
description: Hypixel Zombies helpers: mob outlines, a healing item when you are low, and aim assist that never fires on its own.

addons.ZombiesMobESP: Outlines hostile mobs through walls within a range.
addons.ZombiesAutoHeal: Uses a healing item from the hotbar when your health is low.
addons.ZombiesAimAssist: Aims the silent rotation at the nearest mob's head. Aim only; never fires.
